notes.title: Captain Velvet Meteor: The Jump+ Dimensions joins the Steam Spring Sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342480/da643492f090cdfb3fa7aa4c107b4299aeb5a4fa.jpg[/img]
The Steam Spring Sale is here - and Captain Velvet Meteor: The Jump+ Dimensions is available at a 20% discount! It's the perfect time to embark on an extraordinary journey through the realms of your favorite Jump+ manga characters, including Kafka Hibino, Slime, Chrome, and many more!

Whether you're a fan of heartwarming narratives like Damien's adventure or the thrilling escapades of manga heroes from SPY×FAMILY, Summer Time Rendering, Ghost Reaper Girl, and beyond, Captain Velvet Meteor offers a unique blend of storytelling and action that captivates and delights.

You can also pick up SOULVARS and Arcana of Paradise now, with their biggest discounts yet!

notes.title: Win Captain Velvet Meteor: The Jump+ Dimensions!
notes.notes:
From March 1st to March 10th, we are excited to announce the "Captain Velvet Meteor: The Jump+ Dimensions" Steam® key giveaway campaign! 🔥

How to Participate:
 During the campaign period, download the "Captain Velvet Meteor" Demo on Steam® and post a screenshot of your favorite moment in the game along with the hashtag "#CVMSS" to X (formerly Twitter) (see image example below).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342480/11c61799c012f139898c7552907cbf1d0cf9025d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342480/a388d1dcff4c223e62285cefd3cae781a74608dc.png[/img]

Prize:
 We will be giving away Steam® keys for "Captain Velvet Meteor: The Jump+ Dimensions" to 10 lucky winners through a random draw.

Please Note:
This giveaway campaign is open worldwide.
Winners will be contacted via DM on the official Shueisha Games X account (formerly Twitter) ([https://twitter.com/ShueishaGamesJP]) after the campaign period ends. Please ensure your account is not private and check your DM settings, as we may not be able to contact you otherwise.
All intellectual property rights, including copyright, of the screenshots submitted will belong to Shueisha Games Inc.
Submitted screenshots may be used by our company as part of our promotional activities.

notes.title: Captain Velvet Meteor: The Jump+ Dimensions
Launching March 1st! Captain Velvet Meteor's Story Begins!
notes.notes:
Set to launch on March 1st on Steam®, Xbox Series X|S, and Windows, "Captain Velvet Meteor: The Jump+ Dimensions" will take you on an epic journey! Let's dive into how the story begins...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342480/1740bbc5e659f7b4ff3a426476402ca63f4c87f2.png[/img]
A young boy named Damian has just moved to Japan, finding himself bewildered by his new surroundings. Yet, with the power of his imagination, he confronts every challenge head-on! In the realm of his imagination, he transforms into the galactic hero, Captain Velvet Meteor!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342480/a0f17300058765957a6a86689ad4aada3191fcd4.png[/img]
A 13-hour flight from France to Japan... Goodbye to friends, school, and all the places I loved.

Everyone seems happy to go to Grandma's house... Everyone but me.

I have to leave everything behind and move to Japan. The plane is about to land. There's no turning back now...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342480/71e3daa3e6decc46b14be22b3fa8fec1ff987876.png[/img]
Expedition Log 1: It all started with a simple mission beyond the galaxy.

With my trusty JP at the helm, our spaceship, the Velvet Wonder, soared through space.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342480/6a4c3bcc37f456631ec9b4d01409690a009dc7d2.png[/img]
Then, shockwaves hit us!

Pulled by a dark energy, we spotted a colossal spaceship orbiting an unknown planet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342480/6dde5d846619bd73539ab786e9e5454853bc0661.png[/img]
The massive energy surge caused the Velvet Wonder to fall, forcing an emergency landing on a nearby planet. If anyone's listening, we need help.
I am the space explorer, Captain Velvet Meteor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342480/c61c100fa9ad20d783235dbfd61c07893c37fb49.png[/img]
Following this, Captain Velvet Meteor, along with characters from "Jump+," will battle various anxieties stemming from cultural differences, such as a pet dog turning aggressive due to the stress of moving, encountering unfamiliar Japanese dishes at the dinner table, and finding strange bugs in the bathroom. Will young Damian be able to overcome his fears? Find out in this delightful adventure with Captain Velvet Meteor!

"Captain Velvet Meteor" is set to launch on Steam®, Xbox Series X|S, and Windows on March 1st! Along with this release, the Steam page has received a fresh redesign.
